title: Action list
description: Action widget dropdown (`.context-view > .action-widget > .actionList > .monaco-list`): the list every Agents window picker opens. Rows are 24px, 48px with a detail line, separators 8px; rows can carry an icon, badge, description, detail, keybinding, a hover toolbar (e.g. a summary button or a gear) and an inline switch. The width is measured from the widest row and clamped to min-width/max-width, like ActionList.computeMaxWidth. Hover and arrow keys move the highlight; Enter/click fires `select`, Escape or clicking outside fires `dismiss`. Open one anchored to an element with `ds.actionList.open(anchor, { items, onSelect, … })`; the Agents pickers (<vsc-session-picker>, <vsc-chat-mode-picker>, …) use it with their real data from ds.chatPickers. The monaco list's runtime id is normalized to `list_id_7` in the captures.
usage: Usually opened by a picker, not placed by hand: `ds.actionList.open(anchorElement, { items, label, listClass, widgetClass, role, itemRole, minWidth, maxWidth, maxHeight, onSelect(item) /* return true to keep it open */, onToolbar, onToggle, onClose })`. Items: `{ id, label, icon, description, detail, badge, keybinding, checked, focused, disabled, hover, class, custom, role, expanded, toolbar: [{ icon | label, ariaLabel }], toggle }` or `{ type: "separator" }`. Can also be placed statically with an `items` JSON attribute (and `x`/`y`). Needs <vsc-workbench window="agents">.

attributes.name: items
attributes.description: JSON array of items (or set the `items` property)

states.name: focused
states.trigger: hover a row or use the arrow keys

states.name: select (event)
states.trigger: click or Enter on a row

states.name: toolbar / toggle (events)
states.trigger: click a row's toolbar action or switch
